top_band: light grey stone rim enclosing a 3-row blue water opening ellipse (rows 2-6)
evidence: Reading down column 7: row 2 is the white-grey back rim, rows 3-5 show the recessed interior of the basin filled with dark-to-light blue water (3 rows of opening), and row 6 is the light-grey front rim edge. style.evidence: The stone font uses 6 grey value steps from specular white on the back rim to deep charcoal-grey on the shadowed right side and base, plus a 4-step blue ramp for the water with an interior rim shadow and surface highlight. Outlines are selective dark stone tones with value-only separation on the lit side, matching the Beodeul well reference.
